name: Kakinada Port Link
facts: Links Kakinada port and its industrial estate to the national highway network.
Kakinada is one of the main cargo ports of the Andhra Pradesh coast.
Short port-link highways like this carry a heavy load of freight for their length.
It serves the fertiliser, edible oil and bulk cargo traffic of the port.
significance: A short national highway spur connecting Kakinada port and its industrial area to the city and the highway network beyond. Roads like this exist to get container and bulk freight from a port onto a national highway without dragging it through city streets.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
